source_gap.frozen_wording: CONTROL_VS_CONTROL_NULL must not show excess; a nonzero control-vs-control contrast indicates the pipeline itself manufactures a difference.
source_gap.current_executor_history: two-sided 95 percent donor-bootstrap interval must contain zero

scientific_purpose: Detect a materially pipeline-manufactured linked/control difference without turning harmless residual drift into an automatic failure merely because donor count increases.

candidate_semantics.statement: Require no statistically detectable control-vs-control difference.
candidate_semantics.failure_mode: becomes increasingly strict with sample size around any persistent tiny drift
candidate_semantics.prospectively_acceptable_only_if: the project explicitly intends statistical zero, not practical negligibility

candidate_semantics.statement: Require the control-vs-control difference to lie inside a prospectively justified absolute equivalence margin.
candidate_semantics.advantage: targets material rather than detectable pipeline bias
candidate_semantics.failure_mode: margin is scale-dependent and can be arbitrary if selected from V2
candidate_semantics.prospectively_acceptable_only_if: margin comes from an external technical/biological rationale independent of V2 and K-curve outcomes

candidate_semantics.statement: Require |control-vs-control Delta| / |primary Delta| to lie below a prospectively justified materiality margin.
candidate_semantics.advantage: scale-free and does not automatically tighten with donor count
candidate_semantics.failure_mode: unstable when the primary effect is near zero and can be tuned post-hoc
candidate_semantics.prospectively_acceptable_only_if: zero/near-zero primary behavior is separately defined and the margin is justified independently of V2

candidate_semantics.statement: Keep CVC as a reported diagnostic and stop only under a separately precommitted manufactured-difference failure pattern rather than a scalar significance gate.
candidate_semantics.advantage: avoids pretending an unspecified sentence already encodes a statistical test
candidate_semantics.failure_mode: requires a new prospective calibration design
candidate_semantics.prospectively_acceptable_only_if: the stop pattern is frozen before fresh synthetic qualification

forbidden_inputs_to_semantic_choice: V2 biology G2 pass rate 0.625 at 282 donors
V2 hidden-confound G2 pass rate 0.10 at 282 donors
required_process: Contract owner states whether G2 is intended to test exact statistical zero or practical materiality.
If an equivalence/materiality margin is used, its numerical value and rationale are written before fresh qualification and are independent of V2/K outcomes.
Fresh synthetic qualification uses a new seed family and includes genuine biology, true null, measured technical, globally shared hidden confound, and edge-specific hidden confound.
Power/operating curves are reported across donor count so a rule that changes merely because n increases is visible.
The historical two-sided-95%-CI rule remains reported for comparability but is not silently promoted to frozen authority.
Only after prospective qualification may the Stage4 authorization contract be amended.
